payload.description_html: Teeth of the hybodont shark Lonchidionoides trifurcatum gen. et sp. nov. from the uppermost Albian–lower Cenomanian fluvial deposits of ‘Garet El Hemmam’ (Algeria). (a1–a4), symphysial tooth (LGEE-GH-SA-2) in labial, basal, occlusal and lateral views; (b) anterior tooth (LGEE-GH-SA-3) in lingual view; (c1–c4) anterior tooth (holotype; LGEE-GH-SA-1) in labial, lingual, occlusal and lateral (mesial?) views; (d1–d4) lateral tooth (LGEE-GH-SA-4) in labial, lingual, occlusal and lateral (distal?) views; (e1–e4) lateral tooth (LGEE-GH-SA-5) in labial, lingual, occlusal and lateral (mesial?) views; (f1–f3) posterior tooth (LGEE-GH-SA-6) in labial, lingual and occlusal views. Scale bar equals 500 μm.
